blocks.text: There are broadly two main sources of air pollution: natural sources (14.3.1) and human-made sources (14.3.2).

blocks.prompt: Why are both natural and human-made sources counted as air pollution if only one is under our control?
blocks.explanation: A pollutant harms the environment whatever its origin, so dust storms, volcanic gases and swamp methane are pollution as much as exhaust fumes; separating the two shows which part of the load can be reduced by laws and technology (the human-made part) and which must be allowed for in air-quality forecasting.

items: Two broad sources of air pollution: natural and human-made.
